𝐖𝐞’𝐫𝐞 𝐇𝐢𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐠 | 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐣𝐞𝐜𝐭 𝐌𝐚𝐧𝐚𝐠𝐞𝐫 | 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐣𝐞𝐜𝐭 𝐂𝐨𝐨𝐫𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐚𝐭𝐨𝐫🚀

At Codeflies , we're looking for an experienced Project Delivery Manager to lead our delivery operations and ensure excellence across projects in the international market.🌍

📍Location: Noida Sector 63
💼Experience: 2-4Years in the IT Industry
📅5 Days Working

🎯 𝐊𝐞𝐲 𝐑𝐞𝐪𝐮𝐢𝐫𝐞𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬:
✔ Lead end-to-end project delivery and execution
✔ Drive KPIs, operational efficiency, and delivery excellence
✔ Manage project portfolios, resources, and risk mitigation
✔ Collaborate with Sales, BD, and Pre-Sales teams
✔ Ensure client satisfaction and long-term business success

✅𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐖𝐞'𝐫𝐞 𝐋𝐨𝐨𝐤𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐅𝐨𝐫:
🔹 𝐌𝐢𝐧𝐢𝐦𝐮𝐦 𝟐 𝐲𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐬 𝐨𝐟 𝐞𝐱𝐩𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐢𝐧 𝐚 𝐏𝐫𝐨𝐣𝐞𝐜𝐭 𝐃𝐞𝐥𝐢𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲 𝐇𝐞𝐚𝐝 𝐫𝐨𝐥𝐞
🔹 Experience handling international clients and distributed teams
🔹 Strong stakeholder management
🔹 Expertise in project planning, delivery operations, and team management
🔹 Background in IT services, software development, or digital transformation

📩𝑆𝑒𝑛𝑑 𝑦𝑜𝑢𝑟 𝑟𝑒𝑠𝑢𝑚𝑒 𝑡𝑜: komal.thapliyal@codeflies.com
